## Checklist

- [ ] `themes/<id>/theme.json` with `name`, `blurb`, `mode`, `author`, `license` (SPDX id)
- [ ] `author` is how I want to be credited (optional `authorUrl`); `credits` lists anything I didn't make
- [ ] `python3 -I scripts/validate.py` runs clean (no errors; warnings read and accepted on purpose)
- [ ] `preview.svg`, `index.json` and the README gallery are committed as the script generated them
- [ ] It's my own design, not a company's branding or a product's exact look
